post.name: estate-baseline
post.content:
#!/bin/bash
set -x
systemctl enable sshd chronyd firewalld
firewall-offline-cmd --set-default-zone=public || true
firewall-offline-cmd --zone=public --add-service=ssh || true
firewall-offline-cmd --zone=public --add-port=8080/tcp || true
cat >> /etc/hosts <<'HOSTS'
192.168.90.11 rhel-db
192.168.90.12 sles-api
192.168.90.13 ubuntu-web
192.168.90.14 rocky-worker
HOSTS
alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3.13 100 || true
systemctl mask serial-getty@ttyS0.service || true
echo 'estate ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/estate
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/estate
install -d -m 0700 -o estate -g users /home/estate/.ssh
cat > /home/estate/.ssh/authorized_keys <<'KEY'
!!SSH_PUBKEY!!
KEY
chown estate:users /home/estate/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /home/estate/.ssh/authorized_keys
